complexity_ledger.narrative:
FULL RECORD: specs/results/scorecards/cut-the-apparatus/CA-04/PRICE-TABLE.md (the cut, its price, what the model can no longer express, and what was rejected) and .../descriptor-comparison.md (the before/after basis).
WHAT THIS CLOSE IS. CA-04 removed oracle 4, the mutation kill test, and with it the last hard static gate in this repository. The finding is RM-03-DF-05, which identified this exact cut, declined it because it was a model delta its own ticket forbade, and whose suggested_fix asked for "its own ticket against the CLI model". Removed: the kill_test variable, the RunKillTest action and the KillTestVerdictRequiresBudgets invariant; RunKillTestAdapter and its binding; kill_rate_floor, the mutation_write port and RunKillTest's port row; three kill_mutants.toml catalogues; three spec-unit adapter tests; scripts/run_kill_test.py; tests/test_kill_test.py; and the `run kill-test` subcommand. scripts/ -1,105 lines. The card is untouched at 6,281 bytes.
THE DECREASE IS LICENSED, AND IT WAS NOT LICENSED WHEN THIS CLOSE WAS FIRST ATTEMPTED. The first attempt was REFUSED by this ledger -- "complexity decreased but the validated-refactor basis is UNVERIFIED ... absent evidence is not passing evidence" -- because CA-04 had run no TLC on either side. That refusal was correct and is kept at .../close-refusal.txt. The basis above was then measured rather than argued around: TLC green on both models, the before-model reconstructed from the branch point and verified by sha AND by reproducing the 563,963-state figure the repository had already recorded for it.
WHAT THE MODEL CAN NO LONGER EXPRESS, which is the price and is not softened: nothing validates the representation against the PROGRAM. The model's own comment said kill_test was "the only one of the four [oracles] that validates the representation against the PROGRAM rather than against itself ... none of them can tell a faithful model from a vacuous one. This can." The cost caps have lost their matching value floor; coverage can drift behind the model silently; and compare_reports, the mechanism separating a legitimate simplification from a disguised deletion, is gone -- in a cutting epic. A green tlc_after is therefore WEAKER evidence here than for an ordinary refactor: it certifies the remaining model's self-consistency, which is precisely the property the kill test existed because TLC could not check.
THE MEASUREMENT THAT GOT WORSE, recorded because the flattering version was already written down and had to be withdrawn: the declared bound fell 1,111,320 -> 277,830, and an earlier draft of the price table called that "now under the declared max_state_space_bound for the first time". It is not. `comparable_to_cap` returns None rather than True for an incomplete bound at or under the cap, and the scanner's advisory changed from `state_space_bound` to `state_space_bound_partial`, "INCOMPLETE and CANNOT be compared". The model did not become compliant; it became unmeasurable against the cap. The refinement search above names the move that would repair that.
TWO ORDERED DELETIONS WERE REFUSED, both on the record rather than on taste. kill_test.py could not be deleted whole: five in-repo consumers import its catalogue parser and suppression scanner, including examples/validation/ab/eval/run_controls.py at MODULE SCOPE, which is the driver RD-03 used for the model-derived columns whose zero unique kills is a load-bearing disproof. Measured by parking the file. The oracle-4 half was cut (839 of 1,149 lines) and the 310-line parser/scanner retained; three of those five consumers were found by the reviewer, not by me. candidate_note_bar.py was not deleted at all: SV-06-DF-04 does not say what four documents say it says, "the shortest test asserts nothing imports it" is false (it asserts the card is still 6,281 bytes, the only such assertion in the repository), it is the named reproduction of the open SV-07-DF-01, and instruments.toml declares it with two demonstration nodes. CA-04-DF-01 through -03.
THE MOST TRANSFERABLE RESULT IS CA-04-DF-06 AND IT GENERALISES BEYOND THIS CUT. The epic's REQUIRED loader check greps deleted PATHS, so it is structurally blind to deleted INTERFACES -- CLI subcommands, exported symbols, manifest keys and TOML sections have no basename to grep for. Every cutting ticket in this programme runs a check that cannot see the interfaces it retires, and shipped adopter-facing instructions rot with nothing going red. Demonstrated on this ticket's own cut: SKILL.md:1167 and :1174 still tell adopters to run `tla-spec-dev run kill-test`, which now answers "invalid choice". CA-04-DF-08 is the same defect from the other end -- the validation matrix handed to all eight tickets names `tla-spec-dev run tlc`, and there is no such subcommand.
AND THE FINDING THIS LEDGER PRODUCED ABOUT ITSELF: CA-04-DF-07. A hard gate refused a real promotion, on substance, and it was right. Its decrease clause had been DORMANT for the whole epic -- CA-02 and CA-03 both left validated_refactor entirely at its template default and closed cleanly, because neither changed the model -- and it fired on the first ticket that reached it. Complying with it caught two errors in this ticket's own reporting that nothing else had asked for. The charter carries "static gates catch nothing -- seven epics, zero bugs" among four disproven claims and uses it to forbid adding gates; with CA-03-DF-05's record-checks and CA-05's registry tripwire, that sentence is in serious trouble. This is not a licence to add a gate, and CA-04 added none -- it removed the last hard one.
Eight findings filed against a declared budget of five, all disposed; the overrun is recorded as an overrun. Suite 8 failed / 1466 passed on the merged tip: six pre-existing at CA-03's tip and two this ticket's, both declared, both outside its scope, none repaired.
notes: decrease proceeds past non-gating experimental retention members (CD-09): kill_rate=not_run (UNVERIFIED); effect_conformance=not_run (UNVERIFIED); external_coverage=not_run (UNVERIFIED)

Run `prompts/coverage_audit.md` if you want that read on this scope.

refinement.detail: SEARCHED AND FOUND, NOT APPLIED. `analyze complexity` on the post-change model reports three god-state rows and a near-zero modularity: lastCommand touched by 15/16 actions, result 15/16, setup_phase 13/16, spec_root 11/16, graph modularity Q = 0.002 over the variable interaction graph, with the partition falling into C1 (complexity_gate, lastCommand, result, setup_phase, spec_root, ticket_state -- 6 variables, 15 actions) and C2 (corpus_gate, effect_conformance -- 2 variables, 3 actions). lastCommand and result are also the two variables with NO resolvable domain, so they are simultaneously the densest rows and the reason every bound this repository has ever recorded is a product over a subset rather than the model. THE REFINEMENT THAT IS AVAILABLE: lastCommand and result are presentation -- the CLI's last command string and its structured result -- read by no guard. Giving them declared domains, or lifting them out of the state entirely, would make the bound COMPLETE for the first time and would make `comparable_to_cap` return an actual verdict instead of None. That is the move that would repair what section 4 of the descriptor comparison records as this ticket's one worsened measurement. NOT APPLIED, and not by oversight: it is a model redesign, this ticket's objective says in terms "THIS TICKET IS A CUT, NOT A REDESIGN", and recommendations here are advisory and user-approved rather than auto-applied. Recorded so the next model-changing ticket inherits the search rather than repeating it.

behavior_tests.evidence: specs/results/scorecards/cut-the-apparatus/CA-04/pytest-repo-unit-final.txt -- `uv run --with pytest --with pyyaml -m pytest tests -q` on the merged tip: 8 failed, 1466 passed in 1295.22s. STATED IN FULL RATHER THAN SUMMARISED, because a validated-refactor record that paraphrases its own suite is how a red gets lost. SIX ARE PRE-EXISTING at CA-03's tip 24cd340 and identical there (test_architecture_tags::test_the_same_tag_control_holds, test_goal_baseline_is_a_card::...cannot_be_re_opened, three test_source_citations spec_manifest parametrisations, and test_ticket_retirement::...matching_close_receipts). TWO ARE NEWLY FAILING AND ARE THIS TICKET'S: test_instrument_demonstrations::test_every_declared_path_exists and ::test_every_fast_demonstration_reproduces, both because examples/validation/instruments/instruments.toml still declares rows and demonstrations for the deleted scripts/run_kill_test.py. That file is outside this ticket's conflict keys and implementation scope; filed as CA-04-DF-04 and deliberately not repaired. THE CLAIM THIS `pass` MAKES, AND ITS LIMIT: no RETAINED behavior regressed -- both new failures are bookkeeping ABOUT the deliberately removed capability, in a registry this ticket may not edit. THIS IS NOT the standard the closest precedent set: the 2026-08-04 scanner removal recorded `green` on "no test newly failing, verified test-by-test", and CA-04 cannot say that. The difference is disclosed here rather than absorbed, and the verdict is a judgement the reviewer may overturn.

descriptor_comparison.evidence: specs/results/scorecards/cut-the-apparatus/CA-04/descriptor-comparison.md -- before/after static descriptor, both TLC runs, and the two things the comparison surfaced that nothing else had: (1) reachable states fell by 4.52x against a declared bound that fell by exactly 4x, because RunKillTest left as a TRANSITION as well as kill_test leaving as a state component (depth 25 -> 24); (2) `comparable_to_cap` went False -> None, so the model did not become compliant, it became UNMEASURABLE against the cap -- which corrected a claim this ticket had already written down the flattering way.

tlc_after.evidence: specs/results/scorecards/cut-the-apparatus/CA-04/tlc-after.txt -- `tlc2 -config MC.cfg TlaSpecDevCli.tla` on specs/current at the merged tip. "Model checking completed. No error has been found." 2,505,440 states generated, 124,643 distinct, 0 left on queue, depth 24, EXIT=0. All 13 surviving invariants held over the whole reachable state space.

tlc_before.evidence: specs/results/scorecards/cut-the-apparatus/CA-04/tlc-before.txt -- `tlc2 -config MC.cfg TlaSpecDevCli.tla` on the PRE-change model, reconstructed from `git show 4302082:specs/current/{TlaSpecDevCli.tla,MC.cfg}` into a scratch tree and verified byte-faithful by sha256 (9c0f394c28259fe67848d2b7d45323d759d29bfb8e69c916b010051c91c622ef, identical to git show's own output). "Model checking completed. No error has been found." 13,008,254 states generated, 563,963 distinct, 0 left on queue, depth 25, EXIT=0. INDEPENDENT CHECK ON THE RECONSTRUCTION: 563,963 is the exact figure TlaSpecDevCli.tla's own comment recorded for that model long before this ticket, so the before-tree reproduces the repository's own state count and not merely its bytes.

ticket.model_delta_expectation: EXPECTED AND DELIBERATE. Removing the mutation kill test removes model surface. This is the ticket's price, not its failure; record the delta in specs/current and the desired model and say what the model can no longer express.
ticket.objective: THE LARGEST SINGLE CUT AVAILABLE, AND RM-03 ALREADY IDENTIFIED IT. kill_test.py is 1,149 lines covering both dead levers; RM-03 DECLINED IT BECAUSE IT IS A MODEL DELTA, and THAT REFUSAL WAS RIGHT FOR THAT TICKET. IT IS NOW IN SCOPE, AND A MODEL DELTA IS A COST TO PRICE RATHER THAN A REASON TO STOP -- so price it properly: the TLA+ actions, the adapters, the kill_mutants.toml entries and the spec-unit surface that go with it, and what the model can no longer express. THE FINDING BEHIND IT: model-derived cases do not catch bugs hand-written tests miss -- ZERO unique kills for the generated corpus across six trees, FOUR THE OTHER WAY, replicated on new subjects. Also cut scripts/candidate_note_bar.py: 281 lines, NOTHING IMPORTS IT, and the shortest test in its own file asserts that -- SV-06 found it and it is the first shipped-bytes finding in three epics. Examine scripts/fitness_functions.py against the same rule and cut the dead levers only. THIS TICKET IS A CUT, NOT A REDESIGN: the TLA+ / case-generation / adapter PATH is CA-06's and the owner keeps it. Do not touch generate_cases_from_tlc_dump.py or run_generated_case_adapters.py here -- CA-06 owns them and will need a tree that still builds. If removing kill_test.py breaks a spec-unit adapter or a Test Graph node, THAT IS THE PRICE: record it, do not paper over it, and DECLARE any new red rather than repairing it silently.
ticket.title: Cut kill_test.py and the inert shipped bytes: the largest cut available, and a model delta is a price not a veto
